newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Nafin to unveil small-business plan soon.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Nafin to unveil small-business plan soon.

text.p: Mexico's National Development Bank (Nafin) within a month will formally unveil a program to help small businesses with fixed-rate credits, a Nafin director told Reuters on Wednesday.

"We are fine-tuning the details. What we want is to set up as balanced a mechanism as possible for channelling (funds), and we are detailing criteria for granting (credits)," Nafin Associate Financing Director Federico Patino said.
A Nafin board meeting on May 21 authorized a one-billion-peso package of fixed-rate credits designed to help small and medium-sized businesses.
